profile.headline: Information Security | Airbnb, ex-Cruise, ex-Atlassian | CISSP
profile.summary:
With nearly two decades of experience in cybersecurity and software engineering, I'm an experienced engineer passionate about helping organizations identify security risks and build out solutions to improve their security posture.

Today, I work at Calendly, an online scheduling startup, helping them improve their infrastructure security posture in GCP, AWS, and Kubernetes.

Prior to that, I worked at Cruise helping build out the Cloud Security team responsible for helping engineers securely build applications on top of AWS, GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes. My work here largely consisted of designing and deploying org-wide solutions to reduce privileged access, prevent common security misconfigurations, eliminate static credentials, and lockdown access to production environments. I also worked extensively managing our secret storage / PKI infrastructure based on Hashicorp Vault.

Before that, I spent several years working on Atlassian's Product Security team as the company grew from a freshly IPO'd startup into a major SaaS cloud provider. Much of my work there involved developing the company's vulnerability management program to ensure security vulnerabilities were prioritized and remediated quickly as well as developing production automation in Go and Python to help us solve application security challenges at scale. I also performed security reviews on new services / products, led due diligence security reviews for new acquisitions,  and helped development teams design and deploy major security improvements.

positions.title: Staff Security Engineer, Product Security
positions.description:
• Uplifted infrastructure and cloud security practices (primarily with GCP, AWS, and Kubernetes)
• Performed security reviews, threat models, and vulnerability assessments
• Developed tooling and automation (primarily in Go) to improve the organization's cybersecurity posture
• Worked with cross-org stakeholders to begin implementing production data access controls and reduce usage of long-lived static credentials

positions.title: Senior Security Engineer, Infrastructure / Cloud Security
positions.description:
Designed, built, and deployed org-wide solutions to reduce cloud security risks in AWS, GCP, Azure, and Kubernetes.

Highlights:
• Worked to reduce privileged access, prevent common security misconfigurations, help eliminate static credentials, and lockdown access to production environments
• Collaborated with teams across the engineering org to identify and prioritize security work in their roadmaps
• Developed and operated production services to improve security (primarily in Go)
• Managed secret storage / PKI infrastructure based on Hashicorp Vault

positions.title: Security Engineering Manager, Product Security
positions.description:
Led a team of engineers responsible for the global vulnerability management program, public bug bounty, and marketplace security programs.

Highlights:
• Provided technical leadership and developed production applications (primarily written in Go) to improve our security posture
• Built and deployed solutions for vulnerability tracking, software composition analysis (SCA), and org-wide SAST scanning to help engineers identify and remediate vulnerabilities as soon as possible
• Supported the team through hiring, mentoring, career coaching, annual performance reviews, and compensation planning

positions.title: Senior Security Engineer, Product Security
positions.description:
Worked with product engineering teams to identify security risks and develop solutions to mitigate those risks.

Highlights:
• Performed security reviews and performed threat modeling for new features / services and provided advice to product teams on security improvements
• Identified and triaged new vulnerabilities and provided remediation advice to engineering teams
• Developed production applications to improve security using Go, Python 3, Typescript, React, PostgreSQL, and AWS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Bitbucket
positions.description:
Responsible for building new features and improving performance / security of the core SaaS product

Highlights:
• Developed high-performance web services and applications using Go, Python, Javascript, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Memcache on AWS (EC2, SNS, SQS, RDS, etc.) 
• Led the engineering effort to migrate all customers (~6 million) to the company's unified cloud SSO platform
• Rewrote the product's SSH server stack in Go (replacing the legacy C-based solution)
• Improved CI/CD pipeline reliability and local development environments by introducing containerization

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer responsible for designing and building the company's core SaaS platform

Highlights:
• Full-stack development working primarily in Python, C#, and Javascript. 
• Designed a role-based access control (RBAC) system for enabling enterprise user management and secure access to protected health information
• Built a system for integrating with third-party vendors to sharing clinical and financial data

patents.title: Asynchronous static analysis system for a collaborative software development environment
patents.description: A collaborative software development environment includes a centralized repository security service that monitors a repository database of the collaborative software development environment for change notifications or events. When a change is noticed (e.g., pull request), the source repository is cloned and suitable images are spun up by an orchestrator, each of which is configured to perform a static analysis operation against the source code of the cloned repository. Results of each static analysis operation are stored in a database that can be accessed by client devices.
